purpose: optional finite-size exact-rank diagnostics; not a threshold certificate

reference_certificate.use: reference only; this experiment does not rerun interval verification

sampling.blocks: b=m/D; each failed first-layer block includes all D columns in the rank calculation
sampling.failures: independent Bernoulli events with probability rate
sampling.matrix: fresh independent Gallager matrix per trial; fixed first layer and independently uniform partitions in other layers
sampling.random_generator: Python random.Random (Mersenne Twister); separate matrix and failure streams

seeding.grid_order: sorted and deduplicated; neither grid order nor trial count enters a trial seed
seeding.record: base_seed, trial_seed, matrix_seed, failure_seed in every trials.csv row
seeding.streams: SHA256 of analogous JSON with scheme=trial scheme+'-stream',trial_seed,stream ('matrix' or 'failures')
seeding.trial: SHA256 of compact, ASCII, key-sorted JSON with scheme,base_seed,k,D,blocks,rate_hex,trial_index,erasure_model; big-endian digest integer

verification.core_rows: number of nonzero residual rows; zero rows discarded
verification.empty_matrix: zero columns has rank 0, nullity 0, and full column rank
verification.peeling: iterative singleton-row deletion, including newly created singletons
verification.rank: exact binary Gaussian elimination using Python integer XOR
verification.zero_columns: retained by peeling and included in column nullity
